cwe_content.cwe: CWE-74,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')

candidate.Reason: Directly incorporates user-controlled input (principalName) into LDAP search filter without proper sanitization, matching CWE-74: LDAP Injection vulnerability
Executes LDAP search with unsanitized filter containing user input, enabling potential LDAP injection (CWE-74)
Uses hardcoded LDAP filter which could be vulnerable if combined with unsanitized inputs elsewhere (CWE-74)
